Energy & Inputs.title: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $95 in July?
Energy & Inputs.why_it_matters: Tail-risk bet (2% odds) on crude reach $95. Closes tomorrow. Would lift farm diesel and pass through to nitrogen fertilizer cost within a few months.

Energy & Inputs.title: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $75 in July?
Energy & Inputs.why_it_matters: Tail-risk bet (2% odds) on crude drop below $75. Closes tomorrow. A move this low would ease diesel and nitrogen input cost pressure heading into side-dress and summer ops.
